verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a SaaS platform that holds customer data, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used for AI training is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of any AI-training opt-out, data-use policy or training exclusion. The self-hosting option, which gives 'full control over your data', is an adjacent deployment choice and is not a product control for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
